sentences.text: Hannah Dakota Fanning -LRB- born February 23 , 1994 -RRB- is an American actress and model .

She rose to prominence at age seven for her performance as Lucy Dawson in the drama film I Am Sam -LRB- 2001 -RRB- , for which she was nominated for a Screen Actors Guild Award at age eight , making her the youngest nominee in history .
